description: Track Actions artifact sizes over time per workflow: snapshot totals, first-to-last growth in bytes and percent, the largest snapshot total, per-artifact first and last sizes, and workflows flagged when growth meets a threshold.

growth_threshold_percent.description: Growth threshold in percent for flagging a workflow (optional, default 20)

snapshots.description: Artifact snapshots to track (at least one)

artifacts.description: Artifacts in the snapshot (at least one)

name: track_artifact_sizes
